digest.component_or_area: git hooks installation and pre-commit integration
propositions: The documented curl command to install the commit-msg hook resolves git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg to the shared main checkout hooks directory rather than the linked worktree, clobbering the pre-commit wrapper for all worktrees on the host.

The curl-based install overwrites the pre-commit migration-mode wrapper with a plain Gerrit stamper, breaking the chained hook arrangement and causing the pre-commit commit-msg gate (50/72 rule) to stop running.
The hook installation failure is silent at commit time and only surfaces during git push gerrit, potentially many commits later in a different worktree than the one that ran the documented command.

The install process must be made worktree-safe, non-destructive, and idempotent by folding Gerrit hook installation into make hooks and removing the bare curl command from AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md documentation.

The unsafe overwrite case must be detected and loudly refused with a nonzero exit rather than silently succeeding, and the installer must validate that the fetched payload contains Change-Id logic before installation.
